notes: Deterministic, explainable scam-detection rules for Salone Shield. Patterns are matched case-insensitively against normalised text. Krio patterns live alongside English patterns in the same rule so a mixed-language message is scored once.

explanation.en: The message asks for money or a mobile-money transfer.
explanation.kri: Di message de aks for money or mobile money transfer.

advice.en: Do not send money until you have spoken to the person on a number you already trust.
advice.kri: Nor send money te yu don tok to di person pan nomba wey yu trust.

explanation.en: The message uses time pressure so that you act before you can check.
explanation.kri: Di message de rush yu so dat yu nor go get tem for check.

advice.en: Real emergencies survive a two-minute phone call. Slow down and verify.
advice.kri: If na tru emergency, i go ebul wet two minit. Slow down en check fos.

explanation.en: Someone claims to be a person you know writing from a new number.
explanation.kri: Somebody se na person wey yu no, de rait yu from new nomba.

advice.en: Call the old saved number first. Impersonators always ask you to use the new one.
advice.kri: Call di ol nomba fos. Scammer dem always want mek yu yuz di new wan.

patterns: my old number is not working
mi ol nomba nor de wok

explanation.en: The message asks for a verification code or OTP. This is how WhatsApp and mobile-money accounts are stolen.
explanation.kri: Di message de aks for verification code or OTP. Na so dem de tif WhatsApp en mobile money account.

advice.en: Never share a code that was sent to your phone. Not with family, not with an agent, not with anyone.
advice.kri: Nor eva share di code wey dem sen kam na yu fon. Nor to famili, nor to agent, nor to enibodi.

patterns: i mistakenly sent a six digit
sent a code to your phone
sent you a code by mistake
di code we kam na yu fon

explanation.en: The message asks you to scan a QR code. Scanning a WhatsApp QR code can link your account to someone else's device.
explanation.kri: Di message de aks yu for scan QR code. If yu scan WhatsApp QR code, somebody else fone go link to yu account.

advice.en: Do not scan. Open WhatsApp yourself, go to Linked Devices, and remove anything you do not recognise.
advice.kri: Nor scan am. Opin WhatsApp yusef, go na Linked Devices, en rimuv enitin wey yu nor no.

explanation.en: The sender avoids a voice call. Impersonators refuse to talk because their voice would give them away.
explanation.kri: Di person nor want mek una tok pan fon. Scammer dem de refuse bikos yu go no se na nor dem.

advice.en: Treat refusal to talk as a warning sign. Call the number you have saved, not the one in the message.
advice.kri: If di person nor want tok, na warnin. Call di nomba wey yu sev, nor di wan na di message.

explanation.en: You are being asked to pay a different person's number instead of the sender's own account.
explanation.kri: Dem de aks yu for pay to somebody else nomba, nor to di person wey de rait yu.

advice.en: Money sent to a third-party number is very hard to trace or recover. Verify the person first.
advice.kri: Money wey yu sen to sombodi else nomba at for fen or get bak. Check di person fos.

patterns: send it to this number instead

explanation.en: The message asks you to keep the request secret so nobody can warn you.
explanation.kri: Di message de aks yu for kip di tin sekret so dat nobodi nor go warn yu.

advice.en: Secrecy protects the scammer, not you. Tell one person you trust before you act.
advice.kri: Sekret de protect di scammer, nor yu. Tell wan person wey yu trust bifo yu du enitin.

explanation.en: The message talks about recovering or restoring an account, a common cover story for account theft.
explanation.kri: Di message de tok bot recover or restore account. Na di stori wey dem de yuz for tif account.

advice.en: WhatsApp and mobile-money providers never need your help to recover someone else's account.
advice.kri: WhatsApp en mobile money kompani nor de nid yu ep for recover sombodi else account.

patterns: help me get my account back

explanation.en: The message claims you have won something. Real prizes never require a payment first.
explanation.kri: Di message se yu win sontin. Tru prize nor de aks yu for pay money fos.

advice.en: If you did not enter, you did not win. Never pay a fee to receive a prize.
advice.kri: If yu nor bin enta, yu nor win. Nor pay eni fee for kolet prize.

explanation.en: The message offers a loan or job but asks for a fee before anything is delivered.
explanation.kri: Di message de promis loan or wok bot dem want mek yu pay fos.

advice.en: A lender that asks you to pay first is not a lender. Stop and verify the company independently.
advice.kri: Eni pesin wey de gi loan bot want mek yu pay fos, na scam. Stop en check di kompani yusef.

explanation.en: The message promises guaranteed or unusually large returns on money you send.
explanation.kri: Di message de promis se yu money go dobul or mek plenti profit.

advice.en: Guaranteed profit does not exist. Anyone promising it is taking your money, not investing it.
advice.kri: Nobodi nor kin garanti profit. Enibodi wey de promis dat de tif yu money.

explanation.en: The message threatens you or someone you care about to force a payment.
explanation.kri: Di message de threaten yu or sombodi wey yu lek so dat yu go pay.

advice.en: Do not pay and do not reply. Save the message and report it to the police.
advice.kri: Nor pay en nor ansa. Sev di message en ripot am to di polis.

explanation.en: The message contains a link with characteristics commonly used in phishing.
explanation.kri: Di message get link wey get di sain dem wey scammer de yuz.

advice.en: Do not open the link. Type the official address into your browser yourself if you need the service.
advice.kri: Nor opin di link. If yu nid di savis, tayp di real adres yusef na yu browser.

explanation.en: A number or link in this message has been reported by other users.
explanation.kri: Wan nomba or link na dis message, oda pipul dem don ripot am.

advice.en: Other people have flagged this. Treat any request from it as unverified.
advice.kri: Oda pipul dem don flag dis wan. Nor trust eni tin wey kam from am.

explanation.en: The sender's number is not one of your trusted contacts.
explanation.kri: Di nomba wey sen dis message nor de na yu trusted contact dem.

advice.en: Add people you deal with regularly as trusted contacts so the app can compare numbers for you.
advice.kri: Put di pipul wey yu de dil wit as trusted contact so dat di app go ebul compare di nomba dem.
